description: Maps a billing_contacts row to a scope: a whole tenant, one project within a tenant, or one property within a project. tenant_project_id/tenant_property_id are the tenant's own internal ids (opaque to AmaraData). A contact can hold multiple scope rows across different tenants (cross-tenant billing contact).

constraints.expression: shape must match scope_type — see billing_contact_scope_shape in schema.sql

constraints.note: expression index with COALESCE(...,0) to normalize NULLs
